title: 'Gully to Global' streetwear culture magazine cover lying on a black leather chair
whatItIs: A magazine mockup on a black leather and chrome chair: the cover shows three young Indian models in graphic streetwear on white, a condensed black serif masthead 'GULLY TO GLOBAL', 'Streetwear & Culture' and small cover lines.
whatItMeans: Confident and cultural; a classic serif masthead elevates street style to high fashion.
techniques: Pair a formal serif masthead with streetwear photography.
Shoot the magazine on a textured prop for context.
Keep cover lines small and sparse.
